label: Demo home, HSR Layout Sector 6 (invented building near real landmarks)

anchor.name: BDA Complex
anchor.description: BDA Complex main gate on 14th Main Road, Sector 6, HSR Layout. Punjab National Bank is right next to the gate.

hubs.name: Silk Board junction
hubs.to_anchor: From Silk Board come on Outer Ring Road towards Agara, turn right on 5th Main Road into HSR, then ask anyone for BDA Complex, it's 1 km in.

hubs.name: Agara junction
hubs.to_anchor: From Agara take Outer Ring Road towards Silk Board, after the flyover turn left on 9th Main Road, keep going straight to BDA Complex.

hubs.name: HSR Club
hubs.to_anchor: From HSR Club go up 17th Main Road, turn left on 17th Cross, then right on 12th Main Road. BDA Complex is right there.

hubs.name: Jakkasandra
hubs.to_anchor: From Jakkasandra get on 14th Main Road and come straight, BDA Complex is on 14th Main itself.

hubs.name: 14th Main Road, Sector 7
hubs.to_anchor: Stay on 14th Main Road and come straight about 800 metres, BDA Complex is on the road itself.

steps.instruction: Stand at the BDA Complex main gate on 14th Main Road, facing the road. Turn left and go straight down 14th Main Road for about 120 metres, towards McDonald's.
steps.check: Can you see McDonald's on your left?

steps.instruction: McDonald's is on your left. Just after McDonald's there is a narrow lane on the left with a blue iron gate. Go to the blue gate.
steps.check: Do you see the blue iron gate right after McDonald's?

steps.instruction: Go in through the blue gate. Bikes are parked along the passage. Walk past the bikes to the stairs at the end.
Take the stairs up to the second floor. It is the door on the right with a green nameplate. Knock, the bell doesn't work.
steps.check: Are you at the door with the green nameplate?

marks: blue iron gate in the lane just after McDonald's

fallback.if_no_answer: Leave it on the shoe rack outside the door and send a photo.
fallback.contact: Security guard at the blue gate (day time only)

notes: The blue gate is closed after 11 pm; call the customer then.
format: Each step: `instruction` to give, `pass` = things seen on the way during the step, `see` = what he sees on reaching the end of the step (which means: give the next step). lat/lng = end point of the step.
